page.title: Import buildings and elevators
page.subtitle: Create many buildings and their elevators at once from an Excel or CSV file instead of typing each one.
page.adminOnly: Only company admins can import data.

upload.title: Download the template and upload your file
upload.templateHint: Fill in one row per elevator and repeat the building columns on each row. Rows with the same name and address become one building with several elevators. A row without an elevator creates only the building.
upload.limits: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV (.csv) file, up to 2 MB and 500 rows. Required columns: Name and Address.
upload.dropActive: Drop the file to check it

problems.wrongType: This file type is not supported. Use an Excel file (.xlsx) or a CSV file (.csv).
problems.tooBig: The file is too large (maximum 2 MB).

preview.title: Check the rows
preview.willCreate: Will be created: {{locations}} buildings and {{elevators}} elevators.
preview.includeWarnings: Also import rows with warnings (for example buildings that already exist)
preview.noProblems: There are no rows with problems.
preview.errorsHint: Rows with errors are never imported. Fix them in your file and upload it again, or continue without them.
preview.nothingToImport: Nothing to import with the current choice. Fix the file or change the option above.

confirm.title: Confirm the import
confirm.summary: You are about to create {{locations}} buildings and {{elevators}} elevators.
confirm.mapNote: Map positions are not imported. Use "Locate on map" on a building afterwards.

result.title: Import finished
result.replay: This import was already completed. Nothing was created twice.

rowMessages.elevator_label_required: Elevator details are filled in but the elevator name is missing.
rowMessages.location_exists: This building already exists (same name and address). It is skipped.
rowMessages.duplicate_elevator_in_file: The elevator "{{label}}" appears more than once in this building. It is skipped.
rowMessages.location_value_differs: {{field}} differs from the first row of this building. The first value is used.

entry.emptyHint: Upload a list of buildings and elevators instead of typing them one by one.
entry.settingsDescription: Create many buildings and elevators at once from an Excel or CSV file. A template is provided.

guide.title: Get started with Liftelo
guide.subtitle: A few quick steps and your company is ready to work.

import.title: Import your buildings from Excel
import.description: Upload a list of buildings and elevators. The fastest way to start.

manual.title: Add a building manually
manual.description: Prefer to start with one building? Add it by hand.

invite.title: Invite your technicians
invite.description: Let your technicians log in and record RMS visits and interventions.

qr.title: Print QR stickers
qr.description: Stick a QR code on each elevator so technicians open it with one scan.
qr.locked: Available once you have added elevators.
